title: Xaday
offense_type: Attempts against the Integrity, Independence, or Unity of the Somali State
relief_sought: Waxaan codsanaynaa in la sameeyo baaritaan sharci ah oo lagu soo celiyo alaabta la xaday.

title: waa dhaawac
summary:
Mahadcelin loo jeedinayo dhammaan martida, odayaasha, waxgaradka, dhalinyarada iyo haweenka ka soo qaybgalay shirweynaha.
3. Maamuusidda Nabadoon Aadan Warsame
—	Ka warbixinta kaalinta uu Nabadoonku ka qaatay nabadda, midnimada iyo horumarka bulshada.
—	Muujinta qaddarinta iyo adeeggiisa bulshada.
4. Xaal-marinta Gafkii Loo Geystay Nabadoonka
—	Soo bandhigista raalli-gelinta iyo xaal-marinta si sharaf leh.
—	Adkaynta in la ilaaliyo karaamada iyo midnimada bulshada.
5. Guddoonsiinta Shahaado Sharaf
Si rasmi ah loogu guddoonsiinayo Nabadoon Aadan Warsame Shahaado Sharaf, iyadoo lagu maamuusayo doorkiisa hoggaamineed iyo adeegga uu bulshada u qabtay.
6. Dardaaran iyo Midnimo
—	Baaq ku saabsan midnimada, wadajirka iyo iskaashiga Beel-weynta Aadan Warsame.
